title: National Cyber Security Center
seoTitle: National Cyber Security Center Jordan — Visual Identity | Lōn Visuals
lede: A national identity for Jordan in the digital realm: the Kingdom's seven-pointed star, rebuilt from data, networks, circuitry and the fingerprint, and carried in the colours of the flag.
info: Logo, Identity system, Guidelines, Print, Digital, Events

blocks.label: Overview
blocks.title: A new authority, a national presence
paras: Established under Cyber Security Law No. 16 of 2019, the National Cyber Security Center is the government body charged with building, developing and regulating an effective national framework that protects the Kingdom's cyberspace from threats.

Its vision is a secure, trusted and resilient Jordanian cyberspace, and its work reaches across every sector: training and educating people to strengthen the country's resilience, and positioning Jordan as a regional and global leader in cyber security.

blocks.label: The Brief
blocks.title: Sovereign, and unmistakably digital
paras: A new centre needed a brand that could speak for the state in a domain without borders. The identity had to carry national authority and technological conviction at once, and hold its ground everywhere the Centre appears, from an official letter to a summit stage.

blocks.label: The Idea
blocks.title: The star, rebuilt from the network
paras: The symbol starts from the seven-pointed star of the Jordanian flag, the mark of the nation, and divides it into four parts. Each part is drawn from the language of the field it protects: binary code for data, a mesh of nodes for connection, a circuit for protection and a fingerprint for identity.
Together they describe a single effective system of cyber security working at the scale of the Kingdom, and an opening at the centre, a star held within the star, keeps the national emblem whole.

blocks.label: The Mark
blocks.title: Bilingual by design
paras: The symbol is paired with a modern bilingual wordmark in Arabic and English. A prime portrait version leads, with landscape lockups for right-to-left and left-to-right layouts, each with defined clear space and rules for use on light, dark and photographic grounds.

blocks.label: Colour
blocks.title: The flag, set for the screen
paras: Red, green, black and white are taken directly from the Jordanian flag. A bright cyan and a deep teal bring the palette into the digital space, and a slate grey grounds every layout, so that colour on screen never strays from colour in print.

blocks.label: Applications
blocks.title: From the letterhead to the road
paras: The system extends through a circuit-line pattern drawn from the symbol, an icon set and a data-visualisation language for reports. It is applied across stationery, social channels, the official fleet and event backdrops.

images.alt: NCSC stationery, social media cover and profile picture on devices, a branded black car and an event backdrop with roll-ups

blocks.label: In the World
blocks.title: A national stage
paras: The identity found its fullest expression at the Centre's pavilion and its Government Security Operations Center (GSOC), where His Royal Highness Crown Prince Al Hussein bin Abdullah II was received. Light, circuitry and the star carried the brand through every space, from the entrance corridor to the operations wall.
